description_en: Modifies the API security log subscription
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-log-delivery --instance-id waf_v3_public_cn-uqm2z00000a --assert-key risk --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-name apisec-project-1431657200000000 --log-store-name apisec-logstore000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyApisecLogDelivery

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The log subscription type. Valid values:

risk: risk information.
event: attack event information.
asset: asset information
parameters.help_zh:
日志订阅类型。取值：

risk：表示风险信息。
event：表示攻击事件信息。
asset：表示资产信息
parameters.name: assert_key

parameters.help_en:
The region ID for log storage.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html operation to query available log storage regions
parameters.help_zh:
日志存储地域ID。


您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712598.html接口查询用户可用的日志存储地域
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SLS project.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932936.html operation to query available projects
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务SLS的Project的名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932936.html接口查询可用的Project
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SLS Logstore.

parameters.help_zh:
日志服务SLS日志库LogStore的名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2932935.html接口查询可用的LogStore

parameters.help_en:
